'''Ilya Abyzov Murder At Night''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Ilya Abyzov]]
* '''Published:''' August 1996 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Tatooine: Mos Eisley]]
* '''Strategy:''' Murder At Night
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PANH Murder At Night Abyzov LS 1996.txt |Download]]
